name: 334. Google Cloud Text-to-Speech serves text:synthesize on /v1/audio/speech (google cloud tts) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-6541, contract C3, C4, C5, C6, C12. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. google-cloud-tts is the built-in Google Cloud Text-to-Speech provider with one named key and max_retries 0, as Tokun's reconciler writes it. The fixture answers /pp/google-cloud-tts/v1/text:synthesize by the voice name: a WaveNet voice gets the sample response of Google's quickstart (audioContent in base64), a name ending in -ZZ Google's INVALID_ARGUMENT error with status 400, -Quota a 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, -Silent a 200 with no audioContent. A voice whose name carries another family than the model (en-US-Chirp3-HD-Achernar under wavenet) and an SSML <voice name> element of another family, and a voice object sent as a vendor-specific extra param (extra_params.voice on /openai/v1/audio/speech), are refused with 400 before any upstream call: text:synthesize has no model field, so the voice name alone decides which family Google serves and bills. The rows pin: the unified fields arrive as the text:synthesize body and the client gets the decoded audio bytes from exactly one upstream call; a field outside the unified structure is merged into audioConfig; a field or value the API cannot take is refused with 400 caller_unsupported_parameter before any upstream call; a vendor error keeps its status and carries error_type, from one upstream call; a 200 with no audio is 502 provider_empty_result. The rows read back the bytes that reached the fixture from /__wire, which keeps no header: the x-goog-api-key header is pinned by the Go test. Run the whole folder in order.

item.name: google-cloud-tts/wavenet /v1/audio/speech sends the text:synthesize body and returns the decoded audio from one upstream call (google cloud tts)

body.raw: {"model":"google-cloud-tts/wavenet","input":"Android is a mobile operating system developed by Google, based on the Linux kernel and designed primarily for touchscreen mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets.","voice":"en-GB-Wavenet-A","language_code":"en-gb","response_format":"mp3","speed":1.25}

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') {
pm.execution.skipRequest();
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl') + '/__reset', method: 'POST' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('google cloud tts setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null);
pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200);
var FX = pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl');
// wire: the requests that reached the fixture, bytes as they arrived.

function wire(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); }); cb(res.json().data[0].calls); }); }
function synthesizeCalls(calls) { return calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path === '/pp/google-cloud-tts/v1/text:synthesize'; }); }

function routed() { pm.test('the response names the provider and the key that served', function () { var h = JSON.stringify(pm.response.headers.toObject()); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-routing-info-provider'), h).to.equal('google-cloud-tts'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-routing-info-key'), h).to.equal('tk-key-google-cloud-tts-fixture'); }); }
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });

pm.test('the body is the decoded audio, not the base64 text', function () { pm.expect(Buffer.from(pm.response.stream).toString('base64')).to.equal('//NExAASCCIIAAhEAGAAEMW4kAYPnwwIKw/BBTpwTvB+IAxIfghU'); });
routed();

wire(function (calls) { var sent = synthesizeCalls(calls); pm.test('exactly one upstream call carries the mapped text:synthesize body', function () { pm.expect(sent, JSON.stringify(calls)).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(JSON.parse(sent[0].body), sent[0].body).to.deep.equal({ input: { text: "Android is a mobile operating system developed by Google, based on the Linux kernel and designed primarily for touchscreen mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets." }, voice: { languageCode: 'en-gb', name: 'en-GB-Wavenet-A' }, audioConfig: { audioEncoding: 'MP3', speakingRate: 1.25 } }); pm.expect(sent[0].query, JSON.stringify(sent[0])).to.equal(''); }); });
